title: 可惜不是你

sections.evidence: Systems 0-1 (mm 0-9). Label 'Only PN(arp)Strings in', flute solo. 10-bar instrumental intro ending with vocal pickup '这' on beat 4 of m9.
Systems 2-3 (mm 10-17). Label 'Only PN(arp)'. Verse 1: '这一刻突然觉得好熟悉...不就是我们爱过的证据'. 8 bars.
Systems 4-5 (mm 18-25). Verse 2: '差一点骗了自己骗了你...但我无法完全交出自己'. 8 bars.
Systems 6-7 (mm 26-33). Prechorus: '努力为你改变 却改变不了预留的伏线...但闭上双眼 我还看得见'. Ascending melody and harmonic tension towards chorus. 8 bars.
Systems 8-9 (mm 34-41). Label 'Only PN(arp)Strings in'. Main chorus hook: '可惜不是你 陪我到最后...感谢那是你 牵过我的手'. 8 bars.

notes: 10 systems match printed sheet exactly (total 42 measures, indices 0-41). start_measure and end_measure are 0-based and inclusive.
